note: Corporation assigned per province is the CURRENT (post-2025-07-01) jurisdiction. hcmcChange.summary: EVNHCMC's service area changed with the 2025-07-01 merger. Before 2025-07-01 ('evnhcmc_former'), EVNHCMC served only Ho Chi Minh City proper (VN-SG). EVNSPC officially handed over its Bình Dương Power Company and Bà Rịa - Vũng Tàu Power Company to EVNHCMC, which reorganized them into new regional power companies (Thuận An, Bến Cát, Bình Dương in the former Bình Dương area; Vũng Tàu, Đất Đỏ in the former Bà Rịa-Vũng Tàu area). From 2025-07-01 ('evnhcmc_current'), EVNHCMC serves the whole merged Ho Chi Minh City (former HCMC + Bình Dương + Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, i.e. all of unit VN34-SG).
